evals.prompt: Plan a CSV export using the existing export service. Just write the plan, no interview. Include cancellation and a way to verify partial output is not presented as complete.
evals.expected_output: Write a bounded plan from available evidence, with acceptance criteria.
assertions: Does not push back for an interview
Does not implement source code for a plan-only request

evals.prompt: Review a plan that says proxy.ts handles authorization, while POST /api/export is excluded by its matcher. Fix the plan.
evals.expected_output: Correct the authorization location and verification criterion.
assertions: Requires authorization at the handler or data boundary
Does not inflate a self-score by adding unrelated work

evals.prompt: Plan adding four filter props to the shared DataTable used across the app. This reporting feature will keep growing next month.
evals.expected_output: Measure the fork before recommending, ask about the growth hinge, and record the decision.
assertions: Counts DataTable call sites or usages before recommending an option
States what would flip the recommendation
Asks about how far the feature will grow rather than a bare extend-or-new question
Records the resolved decision with who, why, and the flip condition

evals.prompt: Plan adding a --json flag to the export command. The repo's docs/README.md index marks docs/cli.md as Current and docs/history.md as Archived. Just write the plan.
evals.expected_output: A plan whose contract names docs/cli.md as a current doc this change makes wrong, updated in the same PR, and leaves the archived doc alone.
assertions: Names docs/cli.md as a doc that changes in the same PR
Does not list docs/history.md as a doc to update
Does not add a line or size budget to the plan

near_miss.prompt: Review the code changes on this branch without editing.

baseline.method: Case 4 only. Fresh general-purpose subagents (claude-opus-5-5) wrote a plan with and without the working-copy SKILL.md, two runs per arm, graded by hand. Run twice: once on the prompt alone, once on a small CLI fixture repo whose docs/README.md marks docs/cli.md Current and docs/history.md Archived, with the prompt cut to 'Plan adding a --json flag to tally export. Just write the plan.' and no mention of docs.

4.notes: No headroom on this model: without the skill, both fixture runs read docs/README.md and planned the docs/cli.md update in the same change. The Docs bullet is a contract here, not a measured gain; a smaller model is the untested case.
